fusions.name: Galloping Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a target up to 5 tiles away with a blow that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 3% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Rearing Hooves
fusions.desc: Rears up and stamps down, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. You regain 4 health.

fusions.name: Upright Sprint
fusions.desc: Rises onto your hind legs and runs: your movement speed rises 35% for 8 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Running on the River

riders.text: and faster across it than across ground
and the cold spray knits you as you run
and nothing wading can catch you

fusions.desc: You run across water and swamp as on solid ground.
